[USER] User inquired about statistics on the impact of COVID-19 on healthcare workers in New York and measures taken by the Governor to protect them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] As of August 2020, at least 89,000 healthcare workers in New York State have contracted COVID-19, including 27 who have died.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In New York City alone, over 1,300 healthcare workers have been hospitalized due to COVID-19.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Healthcare workers represented 18% of COVID-19 cases in New York as of July 2020, despite accounting for only 10% of the state's workforce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Governor Andrew Cuomo required hospitals to stockpile at least a 90-day supply of personal protective equipment (PPE), such as masks and gowns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Governor Cuomo ensured that healthcare workers have the necessary PPE and training to safely treat COVID-19 patients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hospitals were mandated to increase their capacity to handle a surge of COVID-19 patients and to transfer patients as needed to prevent overcrowding.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A task force was created to investigate and respond to reports of healthcare facility violations related to COVID-19.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mental health resources and support were offered to healthcare workers experiencing stress, trauma, or burnout due to the pandemic.  
[USER] User expressed sadness about the high number of healthcare workers who contracted COVID-19 in New York and inquired about improvements in recent months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There has been a decline in the number of healthcare workers contracting COVID-19 in New York State as of July 2021, with healthcare workers accounting for less than 1% of total COVID-19 cases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The decline in healthcare worker infections is attributed to the availability and proper use of PPE, increased awareness of COVID-19 prevention measures, and higher vaccination rates among healthcare workers.  
[USER] User expressed hope that the trend of declining infections continues and that healthcare workers can stay safe while caring for patients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Healthcare workers are crucial for public health response, and it's important to continue taking precautions and following guidelines to prevent further spread of the virus.
